description.value: An fMRI study examined BOLD reactivity to alcohol, polydrug, marijuana and emotional picture cues in ADAPS-referred high-risk college students.

spans.text: This functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) study examined reactivity to alcohol, polydrug, marijuana and emotional picture cues in students who were referred to a college alcohol and drug assistance program.

value: the present high-risk sample was expected to show an increased BOLD signal–response to alcohol- and other drug-related picture cues when compared with neutral picture cues, with activation localized in anterior cingulate, caudate and prefrontal regions.
we hypothesized that this area should be responsive to positive emotional cues and to the substance-related cues.
